messages.author: 877cd740823aa09d
messages.subject: Error: /v1/applications/18071/deploy 409 - Unable to deploy application-18071: 1 tasks in progress.
parts:
Can't see how to terminate the app either on the ShinyApps.io admin screen, I get the same error on using the terminateApp(). 

Looked at the similar questions, appears that somebody at RStudio has to do something as super admin to restart things?  

Symptoms:
1. The app was running perfectly and I was just updating an input data file....
2. I ran deployApp() and seemed to be taking a long time (several minutes.)
3. In RStudio Interface, I hit the Red Stop button in the Console header, received the > prompt in console.
4. ran deployApp() again when I got the first error message.
5. tried to terminate app via terminateApp(), received 409 message.


Is there something I am missing as a way to terminate or kill an instance?

thanks!

Kevin Little
